name: framed-criteria-all-reach-the-strategy
turns: Build a comprehensive kinase strategy for Plasmodium.
rationale: Every criterion the framing pass binds reaches the strategy as a step: the build pushes each bound search and the tree the pass set, so the result holds a step per criterion and no criterion is lost between the frame and the push.

provenance.curatorNote: A comprehensive request binds as many searches as the catalog offers for the concept, so the case pins no tree; it checks that a strategy is built, that it counts in genes and that no value is assumed.
